notes.title: 《Toy Fight》has now joined this year's STEAM NEXTFEST!
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you for your continuous support and attention to the game! We are excited to announce that Toy Fight has confirmed its participation in the Steam NEXTFEST, which will take place from February 25th to March 4th. We warmly welcome you to join in and try out the game!

This is a fun-filled multiplayer battle game. When several players are sent onto the battlefield at the same time, an interesting "comedy show" begins! Make good use of the terrain and randomly appearing weapons to engage in a wild melee!

If you encounter any issues during the trial, or if you have any feedback or suggestions, please feel free to join our official Discord community and share your experiences with us.

Official Discord:[url= https://discord.gg/v59S3SX3gZ] https://discord.gg/v59S3SX3gZ[/url]
